name: Progressive Admin
description: Adapts the admin UI progressively based on configurable settings.
project_description:
Progressive Admin Experience adds configurable experience levels that simplify Drupal’s admin by filtering the Navigation menu and restricting access to admin routes.

 Features 
 
 Adds a single, global experience level setting: Newcomer, Intermediate, Advanced, or Full. 
 Filters the admin Navigation menu so users only see the links allowed for their current level. 
 Designed for Drupal newcomers and progressive disclosure 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to the module configuration page: /admin/config/progressive_admin 
 Choose the Default experience level. 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 
 Dashboard: pairs well with progressive admin by giving Newcomer/Intermediate users a clear “home” page. 
 Trash: helpful for safe content recovery while keeping access progressive. 
 Gin Admin Theme 
 Back to top
